Frequently asked questions
Frequently asked questions
What is the MOQ with China Silk?
Quoted per order. Sample orders (1–5 units) may be available with a development fee.
Lead time with China Silk?
Lead time is confirmed per order, plus 2–4 weeks for sea freight depending on destination.
Does China Silk offer OEM?
Yes — China Silk offers OEM / private-label production with custom shapes, finishes, and packaging. OEM minimums 
typically 200+ units.
